# Pull Request

## Summary
Short description of the changes and the motivation.

## Related issue
If applicable, link to the related issue (e.g. `Fixes #123`).

## Checklist
- [ ] I have read the [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) and I agree to follow it.
- [ ] My change includes tests where appropriate.
- [ ] The project builds locally and all tests pass: `mvn clean package && mvn test`.
- [ ] I have added or updated documentation (README, docs/) when relevant.
- [ ] I did not add any secrets or credentials to the commits.

## How to test
Provide steps or commands to reproduce and verify the change locally.

## Screenshots (optional)
If the change affects UI, add screenshots or animated gifs showing the behavior.

## Notes for maintainers
Anything else the reviewers should know (compatibility, migration steps, potential risks).

Thank you for your contribution! 🎉
